description: Native hard reference-distill pressure audit. Train the rejected native-32 parent toward hard rank-1 reference-engine 300k root choices, with weaker broad init distillation.

metadata.parent_result: Corrected native-32 validation rejected the parent: model gate top1 647/1409 on oracle/child targets, corrected 300k search top1 560/1409, compare all 207 candidate-better vs 553 reference-better, capped -35908.
metadata.soft_reference_result: native-searchaware-reference-distill-init-lr5e7-e24 failed: selected checkpoint only reached 498/1400 top1 on the reference-distill model gate, versus parent baseline 491/1400 and required 540/1400.
metadata.reference_distill_targets: runs/native-searchaware-reference-distill-hard-targets-20260525/reference_distill_hard_targets.jsonl: 1400 targets retargeted from the unified corpus to the reference engine's 300k selected root move, with policy_temperature_cp=0 and gap_floor_cp=50.
metadata.hypothesis: The soft retargeted policy was too diffuse to move root choice. A hard rank-1 policy with weaker broad init distillation tests whether the reference-root objective can cross the model boundary at all.
metadata.gate: Preflight pressure audit only. The exported .pt/.nn model gate must exceed 580/1400 top1 on the hard reference-distill corpus before any corrected native-32 search gate is worth running.
metadata.decision: Run only as a preflight. If it cannot clear the model gate, close this reference-distill recipe. If it clears, validate corrected native-32 unified search at 10k nodes with --require-native-net-load before any broader gate.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must beat parent reference-distill baseline 491/1400 and clear 580/1400 top1.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Run corrected native-32 search_target_gate with --require-native-net-load on the unified corpus at 10k nodes.
validation.hard_stop: Reject immediately if the model gate fails or if the unified 10k gate is not better than parent.
